form.official-title: To amend title XIX of the Social Security Act to require certain additional provider screening under the Medicaid program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Medicare and Medicaid Fraud Prevention Act of 2024.
Section 1902(kk)(1) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1396a(kk)(1)) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking The State and inserting:
by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: Beginning January 1, 2027, as part of the enrollment (or reenrollment or revalidation of enrollment) of a provider or supplier under this title, and not less frequently than quarterly during the period that such provider or supplier is so enrolled, the State conducts a check of the Death Master File (as such term is defined in section 203(d) of the Bipartisan Budget Act of 2013) to determine whether such provider or supplier is deceased.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives September 17, 2024.
